independence.method: Fresh full frozen-source review. Findings sent to parent; no other reviewer report opened. Parent later reported working-tree repairs; these were not read and do not alter frozen07 findings.

findings.title: Unregistered physical pixels index starts[-1] during terminal authorization
findings.normal_input_counterexample: A valid catalog identity I2 appears briefly/small enough to fail native track/extraction confidence or reconstruction eligibility, leaving valid archived range/identity pixels but no registry state and no final physical mesh slot. A different identity I1 establishes its current at t=200 after an archived I2 frame at t=100. state_starts={1:200}. No malformed IDs, files, geometry or timestamps are needed.
findings.proof: SessionFrames initializes I2 start to UINT64_MAX, so cut(t=100) records removed[2]. The frame is processed because100<latest200. start_index[2] remains-1 because only in.state_starts populated it. Unchecked vector subscript at576 converts-1 to size_t and updates an out-of-bounds atomic. A closed registered ID also makes latest=UINT64_MAX and triggers the path.
findings.impact: Ordinary bootstrap/recurrent finalization can crash or corrupt memory before saving. Raw physical-candidate retention required by8a makes the input reachable.
findings.native_vs_project: Dropping short/small/unreconstructed tracks is normal native behavior. Raw frame retention is intended. The missing-domain diagnostics index is the project defect.
findings.repair_scope: Keep unestablished IDs unauthorized but count/report them without indexing a nonexistent Start. No native extraction-policy change is required.

findings.title: Native pure dynamic trajectories are ignored by accepted-motion reducer
findings.normal_input_counterexample: I2 has established static current last supported at1s. Native extraction later emits a physical dynamic object with valid trajectory at2s and3s, displacement1.25m above configured1m, and no static mesh. Old site is occluded, so no independent absence evidence exists. This matches the native output shape tested by test_physical_low_motion_fallback.cpp:204-225.
findings.proof: extractDynamicObject creates an empty-mesh object, fills trajectories, validates displacement and returns it. extractObject adds identity/times but no has_dynamic_history detail; the only extractor assignment of that detail is static extraction466. Project hasMotionEvidence tests only the detail. ingestSegments passes empty mesh to consumeMotion, which returns444 before reading trajectories. Archive-wide interface search found no upstream assignment repairing native output.
findings.impact: Accepted D1 fails to close old CURRENT geometry; ghost and wrong temporal state can persist through save.
findings.native_vs_project: Native accepted trajectory output is valid. Project consumer confuses sticky metadata with native accepted-motion contract.
findings.repair_scope: Recognize accepted native trajectory evidence at project boundary/consumer, preserving timestamp watermark and original displacement qualification.

findings.title: Registered tests do not match current camera, motion and owned-evidence contracts
findings.normal_input_counterexample: Ordinary candidate CTest fixtures: session_refusion initializes camera size/focal values but leaves min_range=max_range=0; persistent_object_state creates true motion detail with2s trajectory and expects1s static mesh to survive; temporal_fragment_states submits default-zero ownership/watermark evidence and expects support reduction.
findings.proof: Camera.valid requires max_range>min_range; load280 rejects fixture and require228 fails if reached. Trajectory helper115-116 sets detail and timestamp; canonicalization calls applyPhysicalGeometry, consumeMotion458-459 closes old state, materialize623-625 clears mesh, contradicting336. Temporal look332-338 omits evidence_key,geometry_revision,measured_through; resolveLocalEvidence702 rejects it, so support assertions421-425 cannot test intended behavior. Watched-motion temporal fixture194-225 sets only sticky detail via helper85-87, no trajectory, so it is not evidence of newly accepted motion under5d.
findings.impact: Existing registered gate contains stale fixtures and expectations. Old passing claims cannot authorize current candidate.
findings.native_vs_project: These tests registered in native CMake199-224 exercise project contracts; strict camera/evidence ownership itself is reasonable and should not be weakened.
findings.repair_scope: Migrate all related fixtures/expected semantics, and pass real native pure-dynamic output into registry so synthetic flags do not mask B02.
findings.validation: Static assertions/control flow only; no runtime test result claimed.
findings.additional_note: Persistent-state779 also sets only reliable_samples, not reliable_points needed by geometric successor risk. app/test_hidden_change_session_equivalence.cpp:438-450 already binds ownership and is not in the stale group. Empty evidence preserving current can incidentally pass, but does not test a valid owned measurement.

findings.title: Identity-dependent negative residual tolerance is absent from mathematical classifier
findings.normal_input_counterexample: Ordinary query2.00m, valid measured1.98m,tolerance.05m: same ID receives Supported; another valid ID/background receives Occluded. Identity changes negative geometric boundary from-.05m to-.001m.
findings.proof: Code26 checks-tolerance; code31 adds-1e-3 only for different identity. README6a gives quantization bound, table gives depth-match replacement, but never defines this asymmetric identity-dependent depth-match band. Quantization bound does not derive why reconstruction error is allowed for only one identity.
findings.impact: A shared decision cannot be reconstructed from the sole design document, violating complete derivation/model contract even if behavior is intentionally conservative.
findings.native_vs_project: Own-core classifier/document gap; not a claim that foreground occlusion should be erased or native tolerance tuned.
findings.repair_scope: Define piecewise classifier and geometric/error assumptions explicitly in README, or reconcile code with intended common model.

verdict.reason: Close normal-production counterexamples, sole-document classifier gap and stale tests on a new hash-bound candidate before opening the governing review gate.

formula_reviews.review: Production Load/Fold/Drain/Surface/Save is represented, but ordinary inputs break Surface/Fold via B01/B02.
README46 explicitly calls inequalities evaluation objectives. No proof or measured metric success is inferred; no scoring performed.
Physical identity, independent current/pending/session state and ledgers exist. B02 loses prescribed pure-motion evidence at producer/consumer boundary.
World geometry union re-expresses vertices into merged box. Birth/track minima, support/confirmation maxima and additive source-admitted counts remain separate; closure respects support.
Extraction scope/generation and fallback raw node/observation keys are consumed once. Materialized CURRENT is excluded from raw ingestion. Original unmerged sources remain authoritative.
Completion uses contiguous submitted prefix; production disables detached extraction, backend waits outside graph mutex, terminal ACK follows downstream drain and serialization.
Coverage-gated contradiction, independent geometry successor, retain ties and separate inherited/session evidence are represented. B02 prevents native D1 reaching the motion reducer.

Uniform reliable spatial sampling, equal relation losses, delta=.10m and budget30 are explicit fixed protocol choices. Full triangle/segment distances implement risk; eligibility/time ordering remain separate. Assumptions do not prove physical rigidity.
Session settlement moves resolved fragments and pending candidates with geometry/evidence identity. Inherited and session reductions have independent evidence.

Both actual direct and confirmation clocks are checked against candidate interval. Later confirmation does not erase earlier direct support; promotion uses latest eligible support and closed-support frontier.
Accepted native trajectory newer than current support should close current. consumeMotion instead gates on detail native pure-dynamic extraction omits: B02.

Newest direct segment owns final presence right boundary. Older intervals are individually capped at next direct start before union, preserving finite gaps. Native half-open intervals are reused contract.
Physical query compares decoded radial distance with Euclidean query range in common world/camera coordinates. Projective TSDF voxel residual is separately declared.

Range quantization/domain,16-bit identity, immutable same-stamp content, camera validation and sorted archive are explicit. B04 identity-dependent negative classifier tolerance is not defined by quantization bound.
Backend sets sensor decision cutoff before native detection; explicit and implicit physical snapshots filter by that cutoff, excluding future frames.

Newest-anchor contiguous compatible suffix uses bilateral actual-source AND groups and retaining unknown completion. Minimum classified count and frame subset consumed by native extraction are explicit. Shares classifier gap B04.

Low-displacement physical dynamic candidates use extraction-only static fallback copy; native displacement calculation and true dynamic output stay authoritative. B02 is downstream project interpretation.

Latest per-cell source evidence grouped by actual(frame,pixel), all-absent conjunction prevents duplicate votes. K=max(k-U,0),N=n+max(U-k,0) is retaining extremum of ordered Bernoulli likelihood ratio.

Beta(k+1,n-k+1),equal-snapshot/equal-state moments,cold uniform prior and concentration floor are declared choices. Local/population/pending calibration state explicit; moment matching is not a calibration theorem.
Hypotheses normalize truncated priors; common binomial coefficient cancels. Stable beta tail/log calculation represents integral-ratio model.
Strict odds>99 derives from stated equal priors and99:1 loss. Equality retains. Loss choice does not prove universal accuracy.
Processing starts after consumed watermark and at fragment birth; decision windows follow latest actual support. Empty post-support window suppresses exit rather than inventing evidence.
Fragment key,geometry revision and decision watermark reject stale/foreign evidence. Multiple tests omit these fields; B03.
Empty current yields empty authorization domain; physical raw measurements remain archived. Implementation cuts unregistered IDs yet diagnostics assume they have Start entries; B01.

Production compares loaded/final immutable current keys to reject old physical surfaces on replacement. Conditional replay --tl marks every entry changed/closed and is narrower than arbitrary online identity replay.
Voxel gate implements front truncation and first-current-hit free-space exception. Authorized stale-surface ray limits bound carving; projective residual preserved.
Unit-weight uncapped truncated TSDF and eight-corner meshing match stated estimator. Touched-block acquisition protocol is not a global watertightness guarantee.
Corner supporting measurements reduce physical ID by majority,latest-time,then ID tie. Triangle times use selected provenance rather than unrelated mesh timestamps.

Frozen raw correspondences, upper-median objective,fixed coarse/fine grids,strict-improvement tie and neutral value under insufficient pairs are declared. Conditional scale estimator does not ensure identifiability in every scene.
16 range bins,.5m width,.0005m histogram,1000pair qualification and1.4826 median absolute residual factor are fixed protocol. Nearest originally qualified bin with lower tie is deterministic.
Authorized history prior1/fill prior0; online fill excluded inside fully integrated centroid cubes. Criterion explicit without claiming all missing faces recoverable.
Correspondence window adds positive current scale and prior face-source error; old format uses zero prior error. Negative correction does not expand uncertainty window.
Global first hit,identity,normal/front-facing,range window and actual present support all required. Winding has behavioral meaning, limiting unordered-face fingerprint diagnostic.
One exclusive vote per frame in priority order remeasurement/support/full-footprint free/occluded/unknown. Pixel multiplicities do not become independent face votes.
Sphere footprint uses exact pixel-center ray intersection and enclosing projection bounds. Partial/out-of-image footprint cannot establish complete free space.
Retain/clear losses explicitly assign opposite unit preference to support versus free/remeasured and neutrality to occlusion/unknown. These are model losses, not learned likelihoods.
Loss sum yields retain iff prior+support>free+remeasured. Total tie clears; history prior1 retains balanced observation votes. Different-level tie choices are compatible.
Exact oriented cyclic triangle key within slot implements geometric quotient; history/fill priority picks one representative without arbitrary merge radius.
Coincident representatives select latest color/label,min nonzero first stamp,max last stamp independently of storage order.

Checkpoint binds exact chain bytes and retains live geometry/identity,pending candidates,ledgers and clocks. Load intentionally establishes inherited role/new input boundary; not raw struct equality. Bundle publication is transaction boundary.

Closed-surface cleanup obligations preserve location,reconstruction/support clocks and prevent erasing later independently observed background. Closed historical geometry remains in previous products.

Sufficient active-query state includes mosaics,reliability history,local/population moments,pending records and frozen population. Restored evidence keys reserve allocator. No numerical continuation experiment performed.
Causal query selects maximum stored stamp<=query and returns clone, distinct from native synthesized/interpolated view. Reasoning seed and displayed surface remain separate.

coverage.test_review_depth: Public API call sites/includes and registration reviewed across listed test units; relevant fixtures/assertions read. Complete test-file reads are explicitly listed in supporting_complete_reads. No claim every legacy test body was read or executed.
coverage.equation_map_audit: All351 source anchors/hashes resolve; all43 numbered formulas reviewed independently against complete core source. Author mapping/revision note are claims, not proof.

common_state_assessment.identity: Stable physical identity, immutable fragment/evidence/source identities and source exactly-once semantics are distinct; B01/B02 are boundary failures.
common_state_assessment.time: Input decision cutoff,actual support,birth,motion watermark and presence estimate clocks remain distinct; ordered drain/checkpoint watermarks explicit.
common_state_assessment.geometry: World coordinates,complete-surface distance,projective integration,oriented triangle quotient and source provenance explicit.
common_state_assessment.evidence: Pixel-source deduplication,retaining unknown completion,frozen cutoff and owned-fragment evidence coherent conditional on classifier; B04 leaves that classifier mathematically incomplete.
common_state_assessment.persistence: Chain/shown surface,registry/evidence checkpoints and SHA-bound bundle explicit; static inspection is not measured round-trip/continuous-vs-split equivalence.

model_assumptions_not_defects: Fixed mobility ontology and existing native displacement eligibility are priors/contracts, not RGB-D deductions.
Equal relation losses,.10m scale,30-sample budget,alpha=.2 and99:1 false-exit loss are declared model/protocol choices; no tuning performed.
Beta moment mixing defines a working predictive model, not an independent-sample calibration theorem.
Native track rejection,TSDF discretization,sampling and extraction eligibility remain existing behavior; project adapters must handle their normal outputs.
Equation2 is explicitly an evaluation objective, not a ghost-free theorem.

nonblocking_scope_notes.note: Fixed contract tests final surface conditional on saved archive/chain; it cannot establish full state inference. --tl marks every entry replaced/closed, narrower than arbitrary online continuing-key state.

Canonical fingerprint sorts triangle vertices, so winding changes are invisible although refusion normals matter. No production winding-mutator path established here; recorded as diagnostic limit, not an extra defect.
Native integration read to establish valid producer/consumer behavior. Archive alone does not prove byte-for-byte preservation against external baseline. No external/native/protected file changed.
